scope: UI4 and revisioned minimap component tests with explicit deterministic services/pixels, not a live server/renderer journey or final fidelity acceptance.

cases.name: activeTab is authoritative, independent from a contextual interface, and is not selected on rejection or an empty acknowledgement
bank placeholders echo the displayed bank revision, preserve banker context and reject stale held quantities without rebinding
original book controls retain document identity and authoritative page state across acknowledgement, rejection and cancellation
newcomer-map native models and tutor controls do not invent pages, while supplied map artwork uses native model-only bounds
canonical source233 level-up text uses supplied values and continuation without client XP or fabricated close events
renderer minimap pixels are copied once per revision and stale/reused/malformed surfaces explicitly fail
minimap owner/instance changes clear stale data while observer null/absence and exact timestamps survive UI updates
map-element identities remain exact and missing original icons are visible in diagnostics instead of generic substitutes
